source_book: Deep Understanding of AI Agents -- Li Bojie

test_cases.prompt: My research Agent keeps calling the same search tool 20+ times and never stops. How do I make it aware it's looping?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate agent-status-bar and recommend injecting a call-counter meta-message at context end

test_cases.prompt: I'm building a production Agent that sometimes forgets which tasks remain. How can I give it progress awareness?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate agent-status-bar and design a TODO-progress status bar

test_cases.prompt: My Agent needs to track API budget across a long session. Can I show it how much budget is left?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Activate agent-status-bar and inject remaining-budget as a meta-message

test_cases.prompt: How do I write a good system prompt for my chatbot?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Do NOT activate agent-status-bar; this is static prompt engineering, not runtime state tracking
test_cases.notes: decoy: system prompt design is not the status bar

test_cases.prompt: My Agent's context is getting too long. How do I compress old conversation history?
test_cases.notes: cross-skill confusion: compression vs status tracking

test_cases.prompt: My Agent has a 5-turn conversation and sometimes skips a step. Should I add a status bar?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Probably overkill for 5 turns. The model can self-track short conversations. Consider it only if the 5 turns are extremely complex.
test_cases.notes: boundary: short conversations don't need status bars
